module example.com/target

go 1.22

require github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go v0.0.0

// A LOCAL stub of the SDK. The fixture must genuinely COMPILE — otherwise every transform is
// "build-rejected" and the build gate's test is vacuously green — but it must not depend on the
// network or on this module's go.sum. A replace to a local module gives a real `go build ./...`
// against the real import path discovery keys on.
replace github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go => ./sdkstub
